meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动打开浏览器，访问网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字或链接，还能保存登录状态以便后续使用。
howto.when: 当你需要 Claude 上网查资料、操作网页或测试网站时触发，即使你没有明确说“用浏览器”，只要任务需要就会自动使用。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页，搜索“天气”并截图。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器，执行搜索并截图保存。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，查看最新一封邮件标题。
say.note: Claude 会打开邮箱页面，填写账号密码登录后获取信息。

say.text: 提取这个网页里所有商品的价格。
say.note: Claude 会打开网页，提取价格数据并返回。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open a browser, navigate to URLs, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text or links, and save login states for later use.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to browse the web, interact with web pages, or test websites, even if you don't explicitly say 'use browser'.

say_en.text: Open Baidu, search for 'weather', and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the browser, perform the search, and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log into my email and get the subject of the latest email.
say_en.note: Claude will open the email page, fill in credentials, and retrieve the subject.

say_en.text: Extract all product prices from this webpage.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page, extract price data, and return it.
